provenance.method: Experiment WEB-BIN-001 in research/web-error-bodies.md: read-only Ghidra traces of the katalk MaldiveError constructors, the token manager's status check and 401 predicate, the error-domain mapper, the add-by-phone callbacks and the talk-pilsner client's accepted statuses and its bridge into MaldiveError. Bodies are synthetic; expected values are what the traced code reads.

fields.status: katalk result. Read with valueForKey/objectForKeyedSubscript, accepted only as an NSNumber, converted with integerValue (64-bit) in the status check and intValue (32-bit) in the 401 predicate. 0 is success.
fields.message: katalk human text. Becomes the error's localized failure reason, which the client shows to the user. Absent message falls back to a localized generic text.
fields.reason: katalk: dictionary whose detailCode is read in the 401 predicate. talk-pilsner gateway: string (observed, not read by the traced Mac code).
fields.errUrl: Copied into the error for the UI.
fields.errUrlLabel: Copied into the error for the UI.
fields.title: Copied into the error for the UI.
fields.linkUrl: Copied into the error for the UI.
fields.loginFailedAccountToken: Read only for status 27; handed to an account web view as a token.

cases.name: katalk-200-missing-status
cases.note: A missing or non-NSNumber status is a failure with code 0, not a success.

cases.name: katalk-200-string-status
cases.note: A string is not an NSNumber, so it is treated like a missing status.

cases.name: katalk-200-boolean-status
cases.note: Foundation decodes JSON true as an NSNumber, so the isKindOfClass check passes and integerValue gives 1. mooo should not copy this; see the synthetic suite.

cases.name: katalk-maldive-client-passes-nonzero-status-to-caller

official.outcome: success callback with the body; the caller checks status

cases.note: Add-by-phone uses this client. Its success callback forwards the dictionary unchanged.

cases.name: katalk-401-reason-string-is-not-expiry
cases.note: detailCode is read only when reason is a dictionary; a 401 without a marker reaches the caller as a success.

cases.name: katalk-non-accepted-status-body-ignored

official.error: the HTTP library's error, domain and code copied unchanged

cases.note: The maldive client accepts only 2xx and 401. The shared error conversion copies the library error and reads no body field. Whether any caller reads the library's failing-response data is an open gap.

cases.name: pilsner-200-nonzero-status-through-bridge
cases.note: -805 is a synthetic value, not a known pilsner status.

cases.name: pilsner-200-no-status-through-bridge
cases.note: Unlike the katalk status check, the bridge treats a missing status as 0.

cases.name: pilsner-400-body-dropped-by-bridge
cases.note: Any non-200 status or client error becomes code -500 with no response. The body shape is the one reported in frrad/mooo#424, not observed here.
